best_match.fbbt_definition: Adult olfactory receptor neuron (ORN) that expresses Or88a (Benton et al., 2025). Its dendrite transduces signals from antennal trichoid sensillum at4 (Couto et al., 2005; Grabe et al., 2016). It responds to a pheromone secreted by males and females (van der Goes et al., 2007). It innervates the antennal lobe glomerulus VA1d bilaterally, fasciculating with the antennal lobe commissure (Kaur et al., 2019). It develops from an Naa precursor (Benton et al., 2025). There are approximately 40-50 on each side (Benton et al., 2025).

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00067057 'adult olfactory receptor neuron Or88a', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
